description: Search XSDHub public XML and XSD guides. Returns source URLs and excerpts. Does not validate or upload XML.

limit.description: Maximum number of matching guides to return, from 1 to 10; defaults to 5.

query.description: Search terms for public XML/XSD guides (2–160 characters), for example namespace prefix or XSD enumeration. Do not send document contents.

name: search_xsdhub_guides
title: Search XSDHub guides
